Fuel surcharge and assumptions

Fuel surcharge: applied to the monthly lane cost after the minimum charge is applied.

  • Rate above $80 per pallet → 12% surcharge
  • Rate $80 or below → 8% surcharge

Minimum charge: if pallets × rate is below the carrier's minimum (page 3), the minimum applies.

Growth: the Dallas lane grows 20% in Q1; all other lanes flat.

Do not add accessorials unless the memo says liftgate stops are involved.
